title: NVMe Exporter — SMART
description: NVMe SMART health, temperature, endurance, activity, errors, and all dynamic fields. For nekoyos/nvme-exporter:0.0.1.

list.name: prefix
list.label: SMART prefix
list.description: Empty by default. Enter nvme_ when the exporter uses --metric-prefix=nvme_.

panels.title: Exporter availability
panels.description: Error when at least one selected instance is unavailable. Missing data does not mean OK.

panels.title: Discovered controllers
panels.description: All controllers on the selected instances; the device filter does not affect this metric.

panels.title: Drives: model, serial number, and collection status
Critical warning bitmask
panels.description: Raw NVMe bitmask: 0 means no warnings; any non-zero value requires a SMART check.

panels.title: Percentage used
panels.description: Vendor endurance estimate; it may exceed 100%.

panels.title: Temperature sensors
panels.description: All sensors, including zero values. Zero may indicate an unused sensor.

panels.title: Available spare and threshold
panels.description: The spare threshold is reported by the drive.

panels.title: Data read and written — totals
panels.description: Raw cumulative data_units from nvme-cli, without conversion to bytes.

panels.title: Read and write command rate
panels.description: Rate calculated from cumulative counters. Several scrapes are required; configure the actual scrape interval in the Prometheus data source.

panels.title: Controller busy time
panels.description: Cumulative value, not a utilization percentage.

panels.title: Media errors and error log entries
panels.description: Cumulative values. An error log entry does not necessarily indicate media damage.

panels.title: All SMART metrics — current values
panels.description: All fields from the selected NVMe controllers, including new firmware fields. Raw nvme-cli values and units. Exporter metrics are shown above.

panels.title: Selected SMART metric — history
panels.description: Select the field with the SMART metric filter. Values are displayed in their original units.
